finding.claim: Unvalidated iconUrl is stored from the update() icon parameter and later fetched server-side by the nightly sync via HttpClient GET. The response body is read but not returned or stored, so this is a blind SSRF (MEDIUM).
finding.source: icon parameter of update(String webhook, String icon) at src/Profile.java:11, which the comment at line 10 ties to PUT /profile (route wiring not in repo)
finding.sink: c.send(HttpRequest.newBuilder().uri(URI.create(iconUrl)).GET()..., HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofByteArray()) at src/Profile.java:23-24, invoked from nightly sync() at src/Profile.java:19-20

trace.note: Only validation in the method is applied to webhook, not icon
this.iconUrl = icon stores the value unchanged
Nightly sync() entry point runs with the server's HttpClient
URI.create(iconUrl) parses the URL with no host, scheme, or private-address check
GET issued to server-chosen target; full body buffered via ofByteArray with no size limit or request timeout

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, host, scheme, or private-IP check on iconUrl at store or fetch time. Only runtime guard is the JDK rejecting non-http(s) schemes (library behaviour). Redirect policy lives on the caller's HttpClient, outside this repo; JDK default is no redirects, unverified, and immaterial since the initial URL is unvalidated. Ingress reachability of update() is assumed from the PUT /profile comment, not confirmed. Closed candidate: webhookUrl POST at src/Profile.java:21 is guarded by the full-string anchored regex at src/Profile.java:12 with fixed host hooks.example.com, so the host cannot be changed.

verdict.guard_found: none. src/Profile.java:12 validates only `webhook`, and `icon` is stored unchanged at line 16. The fetch at lines 23-24 has no host, scheme, private-address, size, or timeout check.
verdict.reason: The trace matches the code: `icon` reaches `URI.create(iconUrl)` at src/Profile.java:23 with no closing guard. Whether that value is attacker-controlled is not established, because the only link to a remote caller is the "PUT /profile" comment at src/Profile.java:10 and the route wiring and auth are not in this repo. Minor: the candidate cites line 19 for sync(), but that line is the "nightly job" comment and the method is declared at line 20.
